skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to convert a photograph into a hand-painted watercolor illustration. Triggers on phrases like "把这张照片变成水彩", "转为水彩风", "watercolor version", "做成水彩画", "手绘水彩化", "照片转水彩画", "颜料感版本". It uses image-to-image generation (ImageGen tool with `input_fidelity: high`) to preserve every detail of the original photo — composition, subjects, pose, colors, lighting, materials, spatial relationships — while rewriting the entire visual language into watercolor: wet-on-wet pigment blooms, soft washes, visible paper texture, dry-brush fur/leaf/fabric strokes, gentle pen-line accents for emphasis, splatter dots, and granulation. Suitable for portraits, pets, landscapes, food, still life, architecture, and any photo where the user wants the scene preserved but the rendering swapped to fine-art watercolor.
